title: Fork-drift hazard escalated from precaution to REALISED defect — the watch must widen from three clones to four
description: The repo now carries four hand-maintained ~1000-line stakers (NFTStaker, NFTStakerPriceScaled, NFTStakerDepletion, NFTStakerPriceScaledMigrateReady) with no shared base. The new file is a copy of a copy, and its own header states 'Any future fix or audit change to either is NOT automatically inherited'.
impact: No direct impact. This is the structural cause; CLASS-001 (High) is the realised instance. The repo now carries FOUR hand-maintained ~1000-line stakers (NFTStaker, NFTStakerPriceScaled, NFTStakerDepletion, NFTStakerPriceScaledMigrateReady) with no shared base. The new file is a copy of a copy, and its own header states 'Any future fix or audit change to either is NOT automatically inherited'.
attackPath: 1. A defect is found and fixed in one clone.
2. Nothing propagates it to the other three.

3. The anticipated failure mode MATERIALISED INSIDE THE COMMIT THAT CREATED THE FOURTH CLONE — story-021 named the _safePay → _safePayTo bug in its own body, called it 'wrong in every case', fixed it only in the new copy, and declared NFTStakerDepletion.sol untouched (verified true).
likelihood: realised — this is no longer a precaution.
justification: Low as a standalone structural/maintainability finding — the concrete loss is filed once, at CLASS-001, and escalating the meta-finding would double-count it. Filed as a live finding rather than a watch-note renewal because D-14 escalated it from precaution to realised defect on evidence from three independent converging agents (fork-parity, faithfulness, code-scan).

poc.note: 3/3 PASS, 128k calls — but SCOPE-LIMITED (copy #2 vs copy #4 only, no NFTStakerDepletion, no migration surface). Does NOT test the _safePay drift. The 4-way watch is only PARTIALLY discharged.

labelCollisionWarning: ⚠ LABEL-COLLISION GUARD (orchestrator ruling R-3). Run-20 labels are RUN-SCOPED. Run-20 H-01 is NOT ledger H-01 (858e9e80…) and run-20 M-01 is NOT ledger M-01 (521c20ad… or b58b172e…). Every reference to either MUST be disambiguated by fingerprint, never by label.
